latest_release.name: v0.26.0 Beta
latest_release.body:
## Summary
FreeTube v0.26.0 introduces several notable improvements. Live stream playback is working again, although seeking is still unavailable ([see issue #9044](https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/issues/9044)). New in-player subtitle appearance settings allow users to customize various aspects of subtitles, such as size, position, and color. The playback speed menu has also been updated with a slider and several preset speeds, similar to YouTube's interface.

The update also includes numerous bug fixes, performance improvements, security enhancements, and general UI refinements.

> [!NOTE]
> Due to the upgrade to Electron v44.0.0, [macOS 12 (Monterey)](https://www.electronjs.org/blog/electron-44-0#removed-macos-12-support) and [ARMv7l builds](https://www.electronjs.org/blog/electron-44-0#removed-windows-32-bit-and-linux-32-bit-arm-support) are no longer supported. macOS 13 (Ventura) or later is now required to run FreeTube, and ARMv7l builds will no longer be provided.

## Features
* Add controls to move video to top/bottom of playlist by @caetano-dev in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9463
* Add button to collapse playlist when watching a video by @caetano-dev in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9504
* Channel home: add support for stations by @radmorecameron in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9620
* Add disable hardware acceleration setting to experimental settings by @r3dArch in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9571
* Enable Azerbaijani Language by @alimima in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9757
* Add handling for  `/show/` urls by @radmorecameron in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9788
* Add initial support for YouTube clip links by @radmorecameron in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9532
* Add SponsorBlock channels exclusion list by @Shadorc in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9508
* Add "How this was made" disclosure and AI labels by @caetano-dev in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9749
* Add a reload page button to the player video info bar so you can recover after the player crashes by @mousetail in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9722
* Implement music icon for music videos by @Shadorc in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9985
* Add styling for captions by @efb4f5ff-1298-471a-8973-3d47447115dc in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9987
* Enable About page as landing page option by @kommunarr in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/10007
* Implement links section on channel About page by @kommunarr in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9989
* Add support for various recent timezone changes, up to [tzdata 2026e](https://www.iana.org/time-zones/releases/2026e)
* Enable language support for Afrikaans and Urudu by @efb4f5ff-1298-471a-8973-3d47447115dc
* Style context menus as light or dark depending on the base theme by @absidue in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9551

## Fixes
* Fix live and post live DVR playback by @absidue in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9996
* Fix: changing volume by scrolling does not work in some parts of the player by @Shadorc in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9447
* Fix: Duplicates when click spam loading elements in FT by @Shadorc in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9383 https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9409
* Fix: occasional error with age-restricted videos by @Shadorc in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9465
* Fix trailing slash removed while typing by @PikachuEXE in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9316
* Fix: default playlists not being created on app starts by @Shadorc in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9505
* Fix: channel's posts not loading if the original post of a shared post no longer exists by @Shadorc in https://github.com/FreeTubeApp/FreeTube/pull/9533
* Fix: user playlists co
